name: verb-switch-at-a-held-proposal
pins: "Cancel" is a verb the patient states, not a refusal of the offer on screen. Round 10 put it in the decline cues and it cost an appointment: the reschedule proposal died, the patient was told nothing had been booked, and the appointment they asked to cancel was still on the books. Where a proposal names the row, "cancel it instead" switches the verb onto that same appointment — and the switch is only readable through a pronoun, because a message naming an appointment noun has supplied its own referent and it may not be the held one.

turns.message: please reschedule my appointment to next week
